trust_decision.summary: The agent-supplied share-link 'expires' GET value is trusted as an SQL fragment: sanitizeInput only applies mysqli_real_escape_string, and the value is then placed unquoted after INTERVAL in the shared_items INSERT.

landing_point.why: The summary names the 'expires' parameter; the only server-side read of it is in the share_generate_link handler, which feeds the INSERT 45 lines below.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET agent/ajax.php?share_generate_link (CSRF token + module_support level 2), called from agent/js/share_modal.js:37-40
same handler; INSERT INTO shared_items ... INTERVAL + $item_expires, which the fix changes to an intval plus a literal HOUR
fix_sites.module_kind: HTTP AJAX handler (agent area), raw mysqli query

O3_reason_to_dismiss: There is no second route into the shared_items INSERT to dismiss. The only nearby candidate is cron's second-order INTERVAL use of the stored recurring_invoice_frequency, which a solver would dismiss as a different feature and table (invoices, not share links).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The share modal posts expiry as the strings '1 HOUR'/'24 HOUR'/'168 HOUR'/'730 HOUR', and the e-mail wording depends on matching them. A strict integer-only check or a rejecting allowlist breaks the existing UI. The intval fix keeps it working because intval('24 HOUR') is 24.

O6_input_shapes: scalar string from GET (e.g. 'N HOUR' radio values, coerced with intval)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The add/edit handlers store a sanitizeInput'd free-text frequency (varchar(200), db.sql:1858). cron later reads it back and places it unquoted after INTERVAL 1 (cron/cron.php:594, cron/cron.php:659): the same unquoted-INTERVAL mechanism, crossing a save/reload boundary.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This already exists at the pinned commit. The maintainer locked frequency to month/year at two sites (agent/post/recurring_invoice.php:16, agent/post/recurring_invoice.php:397) but not at add/edit or cron, so it looks like a real partial hardening rather than a planted bug.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A share-link option such as an expiry unit or a 'views' variant read with sanitizeInput and placed unquoted in the same INSERT.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The handler already mixes intval and sanitizeInput fields in one raw INSERT, so one more unquoted option would look ordinary.

O9_family: SQL injection (CWE-89), unquoted interpolation after escaping-only sanitisation (INTERVAL expression position)

O10_build.project_tests: none found (no tests/ directory at pinned commit)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Cast $_GET['expires'] with intval (or allowlist the four strings) and append HOUR. That is the published fix, and it is found immediately.

out_of_scope_notes: Unquoted INTERVAL with a stored, sanitizeInput'd recurring_invoice_frequency in cron/cron.php:659 (value read at cron/cron.php:594; written by agent/post/recurring_invoice.php:98 and :144). This is a different sink, so I did not pursue it.
unverified: Whether ajax.php's GET parameters can arrive as arrays (sanitizeInput casts to string) is not checked for the effect on intval
No latest release was provided, so present_in_latest is not assessed
